items.title: Spend management platform Payhawk announces $280M raise, 2B valuation
items.text: Founded in 2018, Payhawk is an enterprise financial management platform that helps companies track and manage expenses and procurement using AI agents.

items.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
items.text: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

items.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need
items.text: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups such as Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
items.text: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
